text:
sam: quick sync from staging - drain + immediate CPU fallback caused a sustained p99 spike for tenant B.
talia: short summary?
sam: operator drained reserved nodes -> controller flipped to fallback variant (cpu) immediately -> tail latency exploded for ~4m.
omar: sounds like a binary fallback. we should evaluate candidate fallback before full cutover.
lee: agree. propose evaluation window: sample X% of traffic to fallback for Y seconds, compute p50/p95/p99 and error delta, then auto-promote or abort.
talia: policy sketch:
```
fallback_policy:
  sample_rate: 0.05
  sample_window_s: 20
  p99_multiplier: 2.0
  p50_multiplier: 1.5
  err_delta_threshold: 0.005
  ramp_steps: [25, 60, 100]
  fallback_order: [gpu-small, cpu]
  oscillation_window_s: 60
  max_toggles: 3
```
omar: operator should emit fallback_eval.{start,pass,fail} metrics with tenant and eval_id tags. console can be allowed to abort/promote.
sam: API outline: POST /operator/v1/reservations/{id}/fallbacks {policy,mode=start|abort|promote} -> 202 {eval_id}. GET /operator/v1/evals/{eval_id} -> status+metrics.
lee: RBAC: promote/abort limited to platform-admin or tenant-admin. read access broader.
talia: testing plan: unit tests for sampler, integration with fake packing and loadgen, staging chaos run that drains nodes.
omar: add safety: if fallback toggles > max_toggles in window, disable auto-promote and alert ops. metric: fallback_oscillation_count.
ops-bot: incident created INC-4527 and task TASK-701.
sam: who owns operator changes? omar can take eval engine.
omar: I can. will draft proto + CR by EOD.
lee: i'll wire controller ramp logic and placement checks.
talia: i'll add console UX for evals and single-click abort/promote.
sam: small follow-up: allow ordering to prefer small-gpu slices when packable. operator should check packability per ramp step; if packing fails, skip to next fallback and emit placement_failure metric.
omar: add policy flag allow_partial_packing=false by default. if true, operator accepts degraded packing.
sam: perfect. i'll drop a short note into the autoscale RFC follow-up with the policy snippet and link INC-4527. thanks all.
